name: Golden Hour Movement
tagline: Yoga, mat Pilates and breathwork at your SF office, with a rooftop class when the fog lifts.
bio: I'm Maya. I teach at a boutique studio in SoMa four mornings a week and spend the rest bringing classes to teams: lunchtime yoga in a conference room, a Pilates burn with no machines, and a breathwork reset before a big launch.
terms: Free to cancel up to 72 hours before.
backupPlan: Two instructors from my studio cover for me; you get their names when you book.

experiences.name: Lunchtime yoga at your office
experiences.desc: A 45-minute flow in a conference room. Office clothes are fine; a chair version for anyone who wants it.
experiences.allIn: Mats, travel in SF and tax.
experiences.access: Chair version and fully seated option.
experiences.hybrid: Remote people follow along on video.
experiences.setup: A cleared room about 6 × 8 ft per person.

experiences.name: Mat Pilates burn
experiences.desc: Studio-style Pilates without the machines, modifications for every level.
experiences.access: Modifications for pregnancy, wrists and lower back.
experiences.hybrid: Remote people need only a mat.

experiences.name: Wellness week for your team
experiences.desc: Four sessions in one week: yoga, Pilates, breathwork and a rooftop finale if the weather holds.
experiences.hybrid: Every class streams for remote people.
